subject: integration
name: Your own SOCKS5 address
summary: Sends traffic through the SOCKS5 address the person types (Tor on 127.0.0.1:9050, say). Orivon's part is open source and sends nothing else. It is 3, not 4: everything now depends on a proxy the person chose and nothing checks, which sees where the traffic goes and, without TLS, the traffic. What the tunnel is worth is the proxy's; privacy is not claimed. Judged here by its publisher.
